title: Simulation 3D Vehicle with Ground Following
text: Implement vehicle that follows ground in 3D environment, 4 inputs, 2 outputs, {Color} sets Color of vehicle; {Type}, {Path to custom mesh}, {Track width in custom mesh (m)}, {Wheel base in custom mesh (m)}, {Wheel radius in custom mesh (m)}, {Initial position [X, Y, Z] (m)} sets the initial vehicle position, {Initial rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} sets the initial angle of vehicle rotation, {Name}, {Sample time}, {Enable light controls} controls vehicle lights, {Headlight color [R,G,B]} sets the headlight color, {High beam intensity (cd)}, {Low beam intensity (cd)}, {High beam cone half angle (deg)}, {Low beam cone half angle (deg)}, {Left headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw] (deg)}, {Right headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} sets the right headlight beam orientation, {Brake light intensity (cd/m^2)} sets the intensity, {Reverse light intensity (cd/m^2)} sets the intensity, {Turn signal light intensity (cd/m^2)} sets the intensity, {Period (s)} sets the turn signal light period, {Pulse width (% of period)} and {Output location (m) and orientation (rad)} sets the output location and orientation of vehicle. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Yaw
ports.summary: Yaw orientation angle of vehicle scalar
